lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi?
couplets.en: What will you gain by loving me?

lines: Mere haalaat ki aandhi mein bikhar jaaogi.
Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi?
couplets.en: When the storm around me will scatter you, what will you gain by loving me?

lines: Ranj aur dard ki basti ka main baashinda hoon.
Ye to bas main hoon ke is haal mein bhi zinda hoon.
couplets.en: I make my home among grief and pain, and only I could go on living this way.

lines: Khwaab kyun dekhoon woh kal jis pe
Main jo sharminda hua, tum bhi to sharmaaogi.
couplets.en: I am ashamed, and my shame will make you lower your eyes too.

lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi?
couplets.en: What will you gain by loving me?

lines: Ek main kya, abhi aayenge deewaane kitne.
Abhi goonjenge mohabbat ke taraane kitne.
couplets.en: How many more lovers will come after me, and how many songs of love will ring out?

lines: Kyun samajhti ho mujhe bhool nahin paaogi?
couplets.en: With all the stories life has yet to tell you, why think you will never forget me?

lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi?
Mere haalaat ki aandhi mein bikhar jaaogi.
couplets.en: What will you gain by loving me when the storm around me will scatter you?
